ratings.comment: He was the only CS professor that I've had that is so unforgiving with his grading. His instructions with projects and assignments are awful with all due respect, very unclear and he has you read entire documents that are over explaining a concept almost unrelated to the project/assignment. When he grades he also doesn't give tips on improvement.

ratings.comment: I was nervous about taking CS-415 with Kooshesh because of how challenging his CS-315 class was but it went well. 415 is a hard class but Kooshesh does a good job of presenting the material, lots of handouts. ratings.ratingTags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

ratings.comment: If CS315 at SSU is the Dark Souls of CS classes, then Kooshesh is From Software. He respects his students' intelligence enough to challenge them thoroughly but is still fair enough to offer help. Start on projects early, TAKE NOTES in class, like, hand written, and show up to every class early to prep for a possible pop-quiz. Kooshesh is the GOAT.

ratings.comment: Very prideful, discouraging teacher. WOW.

ratings.comment: All in iOS/swift. Few pop quizzes not that hard. Projects such as minesweeper and tetris insanely hard. Expects u to learn and produce results very quickly which is tough. Final project is group and he expects a great/complex final product. 10 page final report that details what each person contributed. Tough class but doesnt fail anyone i think.

ratings.comment: Really great class, not very difficult if you are very familiar with C++. The class is very time consuming so start on projects early, review for tests, stay up on labs. If you need help seek help! Do not be afraid to ask questions. Go to office hours, Kooshesh will always be happy to help!
ratings.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

ratings.comment: Informative, interesting lectures, but this class will make you think & work hard! Start projects immediately, & come prepared w/questions! If not, he will assume you have complete understanding (you don't). Set aside your ego and ask questions, that's really the #1 piece of advice. Don't save it all for office hours as that time is short and busy.
ratings.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

ratings.comment: Tough class, but also a fantastic one. Do not miss any lecture. Start your labs and projects ASAP. Read the book, even if reading isn't assigned. He gives extremely clear lectures, and is always willing to do another example. He will not spoon feed you, so ask any and all questions. Make sure you can write correct code on paper for tests.

Currently taking this class and my god I've never been so busy in my life. He is very good at elaborating dense concepts and will answer your question if you ask the right question. The labs and projects are very difficult until you understand the concept. It is very important to understand the concept. Must pass lab, project, and test to pass.

ratings.comment: Data Structures is meant to be a hard class, but Kooshesh was very good at explaining important concepts. This is the class that makes you start thinking like a computer scientist, not just a programmer.
The best.

Kooshesh can be hard to understand sometimes, but he is always willing to help if you need it. He is really nice, and he truly wants you to succeed in the class.
